name: Wild Shore
summary: The Wild Shore is the southernmost coastline of Stranglethorn Vale, where the jungle meets the waves of the South Seas. It serves as a staging ground and anchorage for the Bloodsail Buccaneers, whose ships lie moored along the shallows.

sections.title: Edge of the South Seas
sections.body: Stretching along the bottom tip of the continent, the Wild Shore marks the border where Stranglethorn Vale plunges into the South Seas. To the northwest lies the fortified inlet of Booty Bay, while a shallow ocean strait separates the mainland beach from Jaguero Isle to the east. The beach continues northeast toward the Crystal Shore. Because of its secluded position away from the Blackwater Raiders' direct cannons, the coast has become a hotbed of piratical activity and wild perils.

sections.title: Pirates and Giants
sections.body: The shore is heavily occupied by the Bloodsail Buccaneers, who anchor their wooden ships in the surf and pitch camps along the sand. These swashbucklers use the beaches to stage operations, store illicit cargo, and plan strikes against their goblin rivals. Travelers must also contend with natural hazards of the shore, including prowling beasts and Gorlash, a colossal sea giant who stomps through the surf, crushing anyone caught lingering along the tide line.

faq.q: Where is the Wild Shore located?
faq.answer: The Wild Shore forms the very southern coastline of Stranglethorn Vale in the Eastern Kingdoms. It sits south of Booty Bay, looking out across the South Seas toward Jaguero Isle.

aliases: who lives on the wild shore
faq.answer: The Bloodsail Buccaneers dominate the coastline. They moor several of their ships in the shallow waters and maintain encampments along the sandy beaches.

aliases: who is the giant on the beach
faq.answer: Gorlash is an enormous sea giant who prowls the shallows along the Wild Shore, threatening both unwary sailors and pirates walking the beach.

faq.q: How does the Wild Shore relate to Booty Bay?
faq.answer: A rocky point separates Booty Bay from the Wild Shore. Booty Bay serves as the stronghold of the Blackwater Raiders and the Steamwheedle Cartel, making the nearby Wild Shore a natural staging ground for their sworn enemies, the Bloodsail Buccaneers.

angles.text: The Bloodsail camps and anchored vessels offer pickpocketing opportunities and a chance to study rival swashbucklers operating outside the Steamwheedle Cartel's law.
